summary: Completed backend + frontend external testing. Backend regression suite passed (13/13). Frontend core owner/client flows mostly worked; found messaging UX/API mismatch, AI UI streaming latency/stall, and a React hydration warning.

minor.issue: Owner thread creation returns 422 when no additional participants are available; UI still allows submit and shows generic error.

ui_bugs.issue: Submit remains enabled even when participant list is empty; flow fails with generic validation error.

integration_issues.issue: UI showed no response and no error after 45s in owner session, while backend SSE test passed via API token flow.

issues: Console hydration warning: invalid nested element in option rendering (<span> under <option>)

action_items: Fix Messages thread creation UX: disable submit or provide inline participant-required validation before API call.
Investigate Assistant UI SSE handling/performance discrepancy (API stream works in pytest; UI remained pending).
Fix React hydration warning from invalid markup generation in select/option rendering path.
critical_code_review_comments: Assistant UI likely needs more robust SSE completion/error handling and timeout fallback state in frontend.
UI currently surfaces generic 422 text in messaging create-thread flow; should map to actionable validation copy.
Keep login-throttle test strategy session-reuse aware to avoid owner lockout during repeated browser suites.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary UI/API test users/records with UITEST prefixes; cleaned up via Mongo teardown. Autonomy reset OFF/cap500000 and service keys revoked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth credentials file is present but contains no actual test creds. Owner login can hit 429 throttle after repeated runs; clear rate_limits or reuse session. Backend regression baseline exists at /app/backend/tests/test_external_api_core.py. Frontend client mobile check passed for hidden staff nav + no horizontal overflow at 390 and 375 widths.
rca of the issue: Messaging failure RCA: ThreadIn.participant_ids requires min_length=1 and backend validates participants against active related users. When no eligible participants exist, UI still submits and backend returns 422; message input never appears because thread was never created. Assistant RCA (suspected): backend stream path is healthy (pytest SSE done event received), but frontend run remained pending with no done/error surface in tested session, indicating UI streaming parse/completion or long-running stream handling gap.
